name: sbom-atlas
description: SBOM files (CycloneDX and SPDX JSON): summary, components, duplicate versions. Pro: license risk review and NTIA minimum elements check. Works offline.

commands.title: SBOM Atlas: Show NTIA Minimum Elements (Pro)
SBOM Atlas: Open Sample SPDX File
SBOM Atlas: Remove Licence From This Machine

walkthroughs.title: Get started with SBOM Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample SBOM, see its summary, components and duplicates, and try the Pro license risk review and NTIA minimum elements check in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
SBOM Atlas reads software bills of materials in the JSON formats of CycloneDX and SPDX: the list of components a product is built from, with versions, licenses and package URLs. Open the invented sample to follow along, or open an SBOM of your own.
[Open Sample File](command:sbomAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Summary
steps.description:
The SBOM at a glance: format and version, the product it describes, how many components carry a version, a license and a package URL, and which ecosystems they come from. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Summary](command:sbomAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Components, Show Duplicate Components.
[Show Components](command:sbomAtlas.showComponents)
[Show Duplicate Components](command:sbomAtlas.showDuplicates)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show License Risk, Show NTIA Minimum Elements.
[Show License Risk](command:sbomAtlas.showLicenseRisk)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:sbomAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:sbomAtlas.reportProblem)

sbomAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

sbomAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
